title: Understanding the source of what we see and hear online
summary: Today we’re introducing new technology to help researchers identify content created by our tools and joining the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity Steering Committee to promote industry standards.
body: Today we’re introducing new technology to help researchers identify content created by our tools and joining the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity Steering Committee to promote industry standards.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布引入新技术以帮助研究人员识别其工具生成的内容，并正式加入“内容来源与真实性联盟”（C2PA）指导委员会。此举旨在推动行业建立统一的内容溯源标准，通过数字水印或元数据标记，帮助用户识别在线信息的来源，从而应对AI生成内容带来的虚假信息挑战。
